description:
Get overall Stacks ecosystem market statistics including total volume, buy/sell netflow, unique traders, and active pools. Returns a time series of daily stats for recent periods. Powered by the Tenero API (api.tenero.io). No authentication required.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

chain.description: Chain to query: stacks, spark, or sportsfun (default: stacks)

name: tenero_market_stats
